acceptanceCriteria: --retain runs rspec with JSON (and JUnit when available) formatters and writes a provider document under .corvint/test-evidence bound to commit, tree and dirty digest before and after
Each example records file:line id, full description, status, and blob hashes of the spec file and loaded spec_helper/rails_helper/spec/support files
test-validity --discover projects association, execution and freshness from the document; producer hints list the Ruby provider
Git metadata is gathered on the host when rspec runs under an exec prefix (e.g. docker) where .git points at a host path, covered by a test
MTV-V0 / LPCV-V0 amended with numbered requirements and tests
body: GitHub #1128 asks 1-3 and #1130 items 1 and 6. testvaliditydoc/document.go:111-173 decodes only JS and Go documents; discover.go:78-81 hints only JS/Go producers; testrunner/dynamic parseRSpec drops line_number and retains nothing. Repro: test-validity --discover on a Rails fixture gives all five axes UNSUPPORTED (no-retained-evidence). Reuse the host-side git observation pattern of jstestprovider/application_attestation.go:328,353 so rspec can run in a container whose worktree .git points at a host path.
title: GH #1128 / #1130 S4: corvint-ruby-test-provider retains RSpec runs and test-validity projects association, execution and freshness
